changeSet.comment: RDR-229 P3.7 (nexus-p2m1x.28): nexus.reaper_expire_quarantine: a row's own origin_collection_id protects it from deletion whatever origin label the caller passed (the count, the select and the delete each also treat a manifest row of that id as naming the chunk), and from the gate 3 latch (the install's rdr229_gate_latch row for gate3 exists, read at the top of the call, as vectors-083-5 reads it) a row whose metadata has no origin_collection_id key is outside the call: never counted, listed for deletion or deleted. Rows are still selected by the label tag. A row whose key is the JSON null marker is unchanged by the latch term (the key is present) and the id guard does not name it. Replaces the definition in vectors-077-55 of vectors-077-rdr229-p35b-readers-both.xml, the last definer; signature, attributes and grants are kept. DATA EFFECT: none, a function definition only. Rollback restores that definition.

changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.28
changeSet.comment: RDR-229 P3.7 (nexus-p2m1x.28): nexus.reaper_expire_client_quarantine: a row's own origin_collection_id protects it from deletion whatever origin label the caller passed (the count, the select and the delete each also treat a manifest row of that id as naming the chunk), and from the gate 3 latch (the install's rdr229_gate_latch row for gate3 exists, read at the top of the call, as vectors-083-5 reads it) a row whose metadata has no origin_collection_id key is outside the call: never counted, listed for deletion or deleted. Rows are still selected by the label tag; the vectors-083-7 marker rule (an origin label that is not a live registered knowledge collection expires only rows whose key is the JSON null) is unchanged, and a JSON null marker row passes the latch term and is not named by the id guard. Replaces the definition in vectors-083-7 of vectors-083-restore-by-origin-id.xml, the last definer; signature, attributes and grants are kept. DATA EFFECT: none, a function definition only. Rollback restores that definition.
